extracted.name: Heart shaped chocolate chip cookies
ingredient_lines: 2 and 1/2 cups of all purpose flour
instruction_lines: Preheat the oven to 350 degrees f and line a baking sheet with parchment paper
Mix the flour with the salt and baking soda
With the mixer mix the butter and sugar together until light and fluffy. Add eggs and vanilla and mix until blended.
Add flour mix. Mix until flour is mixed in and the dough pulls together. Add chocolate chips until they mix in.
Place on tray with parchment paper and use cookie cutters to make the heart shape then put in oven for 10-11 minutes
